three_states: Canonical object availability is a three-state question: registration.path explicitly records the canonical object; registration.path is absent but _store_declaration(canon) derives and verifies ssot/<app_id>/<app_id>.json; or neither a recorded nor verified derived path exists. Current _repro_note answers only two states because it tests registration.path truthiness, so ceftazidime is incorrectly grouped with truly unrecorded canonical objects even though _store_declaration returns ssot/ceftazidime-avibactam-auto-full-review/ceftazidime-avibactam-auto-full-review.json. Registered commit is a separate state and remains absent for 162/162 wider source-condition entries.

Full-tree marker checks were avoided because out/cw/log2.txt records command lines and contaminates grep with the marker text.
obvious_fix: One-line version: change only the Canonical object row to use reg.get("path") or _store_declaration(canon)[0].
obvious_fix_would_fire: It would fire only on the table cell and would not fix the defect sentence. Tested over the 162/163 wider source-condition PAGE_MAP entries: a card-only fallback would change 162/162 Canonical object cells, but current _repro_note(reg, c0) still returns a string containing no canonical object is recorded for 162/162 because _repro_note receives only reg and c0.
